messages:
Dana H: Quick async check — Optimize toolkit delivery: we need owner confirmations for 3 items before EOD Fri: (1) quantization recommendations final review, (2) batching/caching shim and default config, (3) regression alerts + eval baseline. Who's owning each?
Ben R: I can own (1) quant recs. I have the measurement tables, will PR the doc today.
Carla M: I can take (2) batching + caching suggestions, but need infra sign-off from Samir for the default config and e2e perf smoke.
Samir: Heard — infra has a KV cache rollout Tues, we should avoid clashing. Ping me with the exact config you intend to flip to.
Dmitri: FYI opened a draft PR with batching shim: https://github.com/redwood-inference/optimize-toolkit/pull/482 — needs review for interface with runtime.
Elaine: Regression alert: convQA-v2 eval shows perf regression after last quant run — perplexity +3%, MRR -1.8%. Raising a regression ticket: https://issues.redwood.ai/OPT-721
ci-bot: CI report: "batcher_integration" failing on runtime-2.1 in job #482 — failing test: TestBatcherEndToEnd.
Ben R: On it — running the failing test locally. If it's a test flake I'll patch, otherwise PR with fix later today. @Dmitri can you double-check the shim API shape?
Dmitri: Yep, will review now. Quick note: API changed from \`BatcherConfig->enable_cache\` to \`BatcherConfig.cache_mode\` in runtime; small adapter in PR should handle that.
Carla M: Proposed default batching config (for ops team):
```
{
  "batch_timeout_ms": 15,
  "max_batch_tokens": 4096,
  "cache_mode": "prefix_kv",
  "prefix_cache_ttl_s": 300
}
```
Samir: That looks reasonable. Need a short playbook step to rollback TTL flip. I'll add infra runbook note.
Elaine: For the regression, I can run the eval harness locally if someone posts the exact commit hash to test. Ben/Dmitri, can you confirm the candidate commit?
Dmitri: PR #482 is based on commit 9f7d3b2 — that's what's in CI.
Samir: Infra dependency: KV cache rollout will touch node pool labels and a configmap; I'll block the rollout until after PR is merged or we coordinate a canary.
Ben R: Quick commands to reproduce the failing test locally:
```
# from repo root
pytest tests/integration/test_batcher.py::TestBatcherEndToEnd -q
python -m pytest --maxfail=1
```
ci-bot: Canary pipeline for optkit-runner succeeded in region us-west-2 earlier today — canary id: canary-2023-11-06-09.
Carla M: Small ask — can someone from eng-runtime review the PR for any perf regressions? @Elaine flagged MRR drop, want extra eyeballs on serving path.
Elaine: I can pair on the eval runs at 11:30 if that helps.
Dmitri: I left a short note in the PR about where the API adapter lives and a minimal backwards-compat test.
Ben R: Plan: me (quant recs) + Carla (batching) + Samir (infra) + Dmitri (API review) + Elaine (eval/regression) — meet async. I'll push fixes to PR #482 and tag reviewers.
Dana H: Nice — action items summary:
• Ben R — finalize quant recs doc + link to data table (owner)
• Carla M — submit default batching config PR + include smoke script (owner)
• Dmitri — review PR + sanity adapter (owner)
• Samir — hold/coordinate KV cache rollout, add rollback playbook (owner)
• Elaine — run eval harness on commit 9f7d3b2 and report metrics (owner)
• ci-bot — surface CI flakes/tests we can’t reproduce locally
Please update status by Thu 12:00pm PT. If any blocker, drop a quick note here or DM. :thumbsup:
Ben R: Will update by EOD today with quant doc link.
Carla M: I’ll open the config PR after infra check, ETA tomorrow morning.
Dmitri: Reviewing PR now, will leave comments.
Samir: I'll add the rollback steps to the infra playbook and post the link here when done.
Elaine: Starting eval runs now, will paste results in thread.
Dana H: Thanks — tagging for visibility: @eng-runtime @eng-infra. If PR merges, please coordinate a small canary rollout and tag ops-alerts for the regression monitor.
